reason: I like the idea of an agent that can rebalance for me within limits, but this is a brand-new app with no reviews, no known name behind it, and the broker partner isn't even named yet. I'm not handing my retirement money or my data to that, so I'm not getting on a waitlist for the paid plan.
objection: Is my data safe with a new app I've never heard of, and who actually holds my money when the broker partner doesn't have a name yet?
would_change_my_mind: A named, well-known licensed broker holding the accounts (SIPC-covered), plus a real track record of solid independent reviews from people using it with real money.
